div.head: V Atr 1
div.ab: Ðæt is þonne ærest, þæt we ealle ænne God lufian ⁊ weorðian ⁊ ænne Cristendom georne healdan ⁊ ælcne hæðendom mid ealle aweorpan; ⁊ þæt we habbað ealle ægþer ge mid worde ge mid wedde gefæstnod, þæt we under anum cynedome ænne Cristendom healdan willað.
Ðæt þonne ærest, þæt we ealle fram synnan georne gecyrran ⁊ ure misdæda geornlice betan ⁊ ænne God lufian ⁊ weorðian ⁊ ænne Cristendom georne healdan ⁊ ælcne hæþendom mid ealle aweorpan.

Þis þonne ærest, þæt we ealle ænne God lufian ⁊ wurðian ⁊ ænne Cristendom georne healdan ⁊ ælcne hæðendom mid ealle awurpan; ⁊ þæt we habbað ealle ægðer ge mid worde ge mid wedde gefæstnod, þæt we under anum cynedome ænne Cristendom healdan willað.

Ðæt is þonne ærest: þæt we ealle ænne God lufian and weorðian, and ænne Cristendom georne healdan, and ælcne hæðendom mid ealle aweorpan; and þæt we habbað ealle ægþer ge mid worde ge mid wedde gefæstnod, þæt we under anum cynedome ænne Cristendom healdan willað.

The first provision is: that we all love and honour one God, and zealously observe one Christian faith, and wholly renounce all heathen practices. We have confirmed, both by word and by pledge, our firm intention of observing one Christian faith under the authority of one king.

Therefore this is foremost: that we all love and praise the one God, and fervently uphold one Christian faith, and entirely reject all heathen practices; and that we have all committed, both by word and by pledge, that we will adhere to one Christian faith under one royal authority.

First, namely, that we all shall love and honour one God and zealously hold one Christian faith and entirely cast off every heathen practice; and we all have confirmed both with word and with pledge that we will hold one Christian faith under the rule of one king.

Nämlich zuerst nun, dass wir alle (von Sünden eifrig umkehren und unsere Missethaten eifervoll büssen und G2) Einen Gott lieben und ehren und Ein Christenthum eifrig halten und jedes Heidentum durchaus verwerfen; und Folgendes haben wir alle sowohl mit Wort wie mit rechtsförmlichem Versprechen bekräftigt: dass wir unter Einem Königtum Ein Christentum halten wollen.

Namely, first, that we all (eagerly turn from sins and zealously atone for our misdeeds, and, G2) love and honour one God and eagerly hold one Christian faith and utterly reject all heathenism; and we have all confirmed the following both by word and by formal pledge: that we will hold one Christian faith under one kingship.
div.note: V Atr 22; VIII Atr 44.1; IX Atr 1; II Cn 1

VI Ethelred, after speaking of heathenism, has the following chapter (7): “And if wizards or sorcerers, magicians or whores, murderers or perjurers are caught anywhere in the land, they are to be zealously driven out of this country, and this nation is to be cleansed, or they are to be utterly destroyed in this country, unless they desist and atone very deeply.”
